t: An open, 3D-printed humanoid robot from UC Berkeley for walking research.
steps: Read the Berkeley Humanoid Lite docs on GitBook from start to finish.
Order parts from the public parts sheet, which links to Amazon and Taobao.
Print one actuator from the MakerWorld files and assemble it.
Install STM32CubeIDE and flash the Recoil firmware onto a motor driver board.
Spin that single actuator from the mini PC over a USB-CAN adapter.
Build the rest of the actuators and set each CAN ID from the joint map.
Install Isaac Lab on a computer with an NVIDIA graphics card and try the walking example in simulation.
